_about: Ordinovix work queue for Claude Code. Units run in order, respecting depends_on. Claude may edit only status, pr, evidence and notes. Bug IDs refer to docs/state/QA_AUDIT_2026-10-27.md.

phases.P0: Demo-ready: fix what would break or embarrass the operator preview
phases.P2: Contract hardening: make the mock the executable spec for the API
phases.P3-prep: Backend preparation, documents only (no cloud actions)

units.title: Quality gate tooling + fix the Rules-of-Hooks crash
acceptance: Install exact-pinned devDependencies from docs/adr/approved-deps.json group 'gate': @playwright/test, eslint, @eslint/js, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, globals (latest stable, at least 7 days old, --save-exact)
vite.config.ts gains a Vitest `test` block that includes only src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, so Vitest never runs tests/acceptance
package.json scripts: lint = eslint ., test:e2e = playwright test, verify = node scripts/verify.mjs, verify:fast = node scripts/verify.mjs --fast
record.tsx and summary.tsx call every hook before the loading return (B01); `npx eslint .` reports 0 errors
B01 removed from known-failures.json; `node scripts/verify.mjs` exits 0 with all other regression IDs still listed
CI workflow .github/workflows/verify.yml passes on the PR
units.notes: Bootstrap unit: main is red until U00 merges (the gate tooling is not installed yet and CI on main fails). Skip the broken-base check for this unit only. Open the PR and let CI prove the gate.

units.title: Finish visit requires every outcome to be saved
acceptance: Finish Visit is disabled until every item has a SAVED outcome; the counter shows saved outcomes only
visits.finish rejects (RULE_VIOLATION) when any item lacks a saved outcome; a Vitest test proves it
Add pure rule canFinishVisit(items) in rules.ts with tests

units.title: Blocked tasks change status only through an owner override with a reason
acceptance: canSetStatus returns false for every target when the task is blocked, for every role
tasks.setStatus, markSubmitted and markCompleted enforce canSetStatus; markCompleted also enforces the evidence-or-reason rule (spec 12.7)
tasks.override(id, status, reason) remains the only path for a blocked task; it records statusOverride and an activity event
Board drag and 'Move to…' show the rule's reason instead of moving a blocked task
Vitest covers each row of spec table 16.4

units.title: Task templates screen and Welcome wizard read real templates; no fabricated 'Verified' badges
acceptance: Settings → Task templates lists templates from useTemplates() with their real code, name, frequency, line count and verification state
Mark verified calls templates.markVerified and requires a source reference (spec 12.10)
No hard-coded template arrays or legal references remain in settings or welcome pages

units.title: Valid notification links, dev tools only in mock mode, pinch zoom restored
acceptance: Every seeded notification links to an existing task, visit or client
Dev menu, persona switcher and 'Sample Data Mode' banner render only when VITE_DATA_SOURCE is not 'api'
index.html viewport no longer sets maximum-scale or user-scalable=no

units.title: Enrich sample data to spec section 18 (demo-ready)
acceptance: Keep every seed ID listed in .claude/rules/domain-data.md with its starting state; never add items to visit-today

Add clients up to 8 (spec 18.2), all 9 sample templates (all unverified), about 26 open tasks covering every task status and every line status, visits V1 (not ready), V2 (ready), V3 (done) as NEW visits, follow-ups, payments, documents, notifications, notes, activity
Add six months of history shaped like spec table 18.6 so Insights can be computed later
All dates relative to the seed day; seeded visit dates never fall on weekends or seeded holidays
All regression tests that passed before still pass; mock repository tests updated only where counts changed
Write 'Demo ready' in the PROGRESS.md entry; continue to the next unit (no stop)

units.title: Shared QueryState wrapper: loading, error with Retry, 403/404, empty on every data page; real error page
acceptance: One QueryState component used by every data-backed page: calendar, clients/page, clients/detail, documents, follow-ups/run, insights, notifications, offices, payments, search, settings, tasks/page, visits/page, visits/detail, visits/print, visits/record, visits/summary (the 17 route files in audit B13)
Unknown record → not-found message; unassigned client for the helper → no-access message (spec 11.20 copy)
Router errorElement renders a real error page with an error ID, not the 404 page
With the dev failure rate at 100%, every page shows its own error and Retry; navigation keeps working

units.title: Permission policy enforced in the data layer
acceptance: src/domain/policy.ts: pure canAccessClient, requireOwner, canReviewLines (respects helpersCanAccept), canViewInsights scope, with Vitest tests

Every mock repository method calls policy first; helpers get FORBIDDEN on unassigned clients for reads AND writes (contacts, authorizations, tasks, lines, documents, follow-ups, visits, payments, notes, calendar, search, insights, reports)
Owner-only methods (memberships, templates.save/markVerified, deadlineMoves, holidays, settings.save, tasks.override/changeDue, reports.fullBackup, activity.list org-wide) reject helpers
Verifier performs a red-on-removal check for at least canAccessClient and requireOwner

units.title: Validate every write with the zod schemas at the repository boundary
acceptance: Schemas match spec section 12 field rules (lengths, required fields, centavos, YYYY-MM-DD, reason ≥ 10 chars)
Every write method parses input and throws VALIDATION with field errors; forms show those errors next to the fields
No form rewrite to react-hook-form is required

units.title: Uploaded files persist across reloads (IndexedDB)
acceptance: Mock stores file bytes and thumbnails in IndexedDB via idb-keyval; documents.getUrl mints a fresh object URL
Upload applies the spec 9.9 display name convention and respects line transitions instead of forcing Received
Replace creates a new version record (versionNo + replacesId), never mutating the old one
fake-indexeddb (approved) may be added for Vitest

units.title: Settings saves for real: split the 1,870-line page into wired sections
acceptance: One component per settings section; each loads from and saves to its repository method (settings.save, prefs.save, messages.save, holidays.*, deadlineMoves.*, visitKit.save)
Forms initialise from loaded data, not hard-coded defaults; 'Settings saved' only after success; errors shown inline
Visual layout unchanged

units.title: Audit log shows real activity
acceptance: Audit page renders activity.list() with the filters and built-in views from spec 11.18; CSV export uses the same data
No activity event stores a revealed TIN or secret in before/after

units.title: Insights computed from data with metrics.ts, filters and helper scoping
acceptance: Every KPI and chart in spec 13.3–13.4 is computed by a pure metrics.ts function with a Vitest hand-count test on fixed fixtures
Insights page contains no hard-coded series; filters (date range, owner, client, template) change the numbers
Helper sees only assigned clients' numbers
Charts keep their current look; one y-axis per chart; table view and CSV per chart

units.title: Welcome wizard persists what it collects
acceptance: Each step saves through the repository (settings, template activation, invite) and the Today 'Getting started' card reflects progress

units.title: Small correctness fixes batch
acceptance: Visit cost fields start empty (B15); pack list copies default to 1 for Originals and to the template value otherwise (B22)
Summary shows 'Not recorded' instead of a made-up duration (B23)
formatTime/formatDateTime render Asia/Manila regardless of device time zone (B25) with tests
Task header shows 'Sep 2026' style period labels (B28)
Rename the 'Bureau Vermilion — official BIR carmine' palette to a neutral name and description without BIR references (B29)

units.title: Dev menu 'set today' survives its reload
acceptance: The override persists in localStorage, is applied before the store loads, and can be cleared

units.title: Bundle split and dependency cleanup
acceptance: All routes except Today lazy-loaded; initial JS ≤ 220 KB gzip (report the number)

Remove dependencies with zero imports: recharts, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, @tanstack/react-table, @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, @dnd-kit/utilities, react-day-picker, vaul — re-check with grep first; keep idb-keyval and @date-fns/tz if used
No major-version upgrades

units.title: Installable app and offline write queue
acceptance: vite-plugin-pwa (approved) generates the service worker per spec 19.3; update banner instead of silent reloads
Offline mutations queue in IndexedDB with idempotency keys, replay in order on reconnect, show in the sync indicator; no duplicates after replay (test with the dev offline toggle)
PNG icons 192/512/maskable and apple-touch-icon 180 added alongside the SVGs

units.title: Accessibility and responsive sweep
acceptance: Add @axe-core/playwright (approved) checks for the main routes in both themes; zero serious or critical violations
No horizontal scroll at 360 px on any route (new acceptance test)
Visual look unchanged except where an accessibility fix requires it

units.title: Backend plan document (no cloud actions)
acceptance: docs/backend/BACKEND_PLAN.md maps every Repositories method to an API route, permission rule and D1 tables (spec section 21)
docs/backend/schema-draft.sql: D1 table draft with indexes from spec 21.6 (not applied anywhere)
List of owner decisions and accounts needed (Cloudflare, Google OAuth client, secrets) appended to QUEUE.md
No wrangler, Cloudflare or OAuth commands run
